argv: $d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads'; Get-ChildItem $d -File | Where-Object {$_.Extension -match '^\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$'} | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Length,@{n='MTimeUtc';e={$_.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')}},@{n='SHA256';e={(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress
